notes.title: New update is now live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37271994/172866827a9fc717fdd39cf9a7f7c869748ede4c.png

The new patch for Ultimate Ski Jumping 2020 is now live!
Read the patch note below:

Adjustments:
- Adjusted fly physics
- Animated UI

New Content:
- 2 new winter hills
- New clothes in the shop
- Jump indication functionality
- Additional chapter of Campaign mode (2nd season)
- Quick Jump mode added
- New background music added
- Added camera shake when landing badly
- Upgraded summary screen with winning jumper art
